title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Courtesy Desk Schedule: Prior-Courtesy Adjustment
content:
**Schedule.** On a courtesy credit for a late fee on a Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards account, the prior-courtesy adjustment is added to the courtesy share, the share of the late fee being reversed that the courtesy credit returns. It is minus 0.25 when a fee reversal with the reversal reason courtesy waiver has a transaction date fewer than 6 full calendar months before today, minus 0.1 when there is such a reversal dated fewer than 12 full calendar months before today but none dated fewer than 6, and zero when there is none dated fewer than 12 full calendar months before today. The courtesy share is never below zero and never above 1.0.

The records read are the account's fee reversals carrying the reason courtesy waiver, by transaction date.

| Most recent courtesy reversal | Prior-courtesy adjustment |
|---|---|
| fewer than 6 full calendar months before today | minus 0.25 |
| at least 6 but fewer than 12 full calendar months before today | minus 0.1 |
| none fewer than 12 full calendar months before today | zero |

## Cases (hypothetical; today 20 September)

| Courtesy reversals on the account | Adjustment |
|---|---|
| one dated 1 June of this year | minus 0.25 |
| one dated 1 January of this year | minus 0.1 |
| one dated 1 June of last year | zero |
| one dated 1 January and one dated 1 August of this year | minus 0.25 |
| none | zero |
